title: GBA: add BG2/BG3 affine register file (PA/PB/PC/PD, X/Y)
body:
The umbrella issue tracks affine BG/sprites, windows, blending and mosaic for the GBA PPU. Its prerequisite — Mode 0/1/2 tile-map and OAM/sprite rendering — isn't in tree yet (the PPU only does Mode 3 bitmap), so the full scope can't land in one PR. This change delivers the first self-contained foundation piece every later affine increment will read from.

### Changes

- **`src/gba/ppu/affine.rs` (new)** — `BgAffine` struct: PA/PB/PC/PD as signed 8.8 `i16`, X/Y as signed 19.8 `i32`. Halfword write helpers sign-extend bit 27 of the 28-bit hardware field and discard the unused top nibble per GBATek.
- **`src/gba/ppu/mod.rs`** — `Ppu` owns `[BgAffine; 2]` (idx 0 = BG2, 1 = BG3), exposes `bg_affine(idx) -> Option<&BgAffine>` (non-panicking, via `slice::get`) for the future renderer, a `write_affine(addr, value)` dispatcher covering `0x0400_0020..=0x0400_003E`, and a `read_affine(addr) -> Option<u16>` accessor that exposes the live latched halfword for the byte-write read-modify-write path on the bus.
- **`src/gba/bus/io.rs`** — routes those 16 halfword writes into the PPU. Reads fall through to the I/O backing store, preserving write-only / open-bus semantics. `write8` has a dedicated byte-merge path for `0x0400_0020..=0x0400_003E` (mirroring the DMA special-case) that merges against `Ppu::read_affine` instead of the open-bus backing store, so two consecutive byte writes to e.g. `BG2PA` or `BG2X_L` no longer clobber each other.
- **`architecture.md`** — documents the new module and the PPU's expanded ownership.

### Sign-extension detail

```rust
// 28-bit signed field stored in low bits of a u32 → full i32
fn sign_extend_28(value: u32) -> i32 {
    let masked = (value & 0x0FFF_FFFF) as i32;
    (masked << 4) >> 4   // arithmetic shift copies bit 27 into bits 28..31
}
```

So `BG2Y_H = 0x0FFF`, `BG2Y_L = 0xFFFF` latches as `-1`, and stray bits 28..31 in the high halfword are dropped.

### Tests (TDD)

13 new tests covering: defaults, signed 8.8 round-trip, X/Y low/high composition order independence, top-nibble discard, bit-27 sign extension (X and Y), BG2/BG3 register isolation, no-match address rejection, `bg_affine` returning `None` for out-of-range indices, an end-to-end bus test asserting halfword writes reach the PPU while reads stay open-bus, and a byte-write test asserting two consecutive byte writes to `BG2PA` and `BG2X_L` merge correctly into the live PPU state without clobbering through open-bus.

### Out of scope (follow-up sub-issues)

Mode 0/1/2 tile rendering, OAM/sprite rendering, the affine renderer that consumes this state, per-scanline reference-point latching for H-Blank-DMA effects, affine sprites, WIN0/WIN1/WINOBJ/WINOUT, BLDCNT/BLDALPHA/BLDY, MOSAIC, and the reviewed-screenshot + CRC test ROM.
